subject: Nebula Systems — early-exit & ramp addendum request
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@nebulasys.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulasys.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Request: proposal tweak for early-exit & ramp wording

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Nebula is excited about the latency profile and the cost delta for embeddings. Procurement asked me to run a small change by you: during our 6-month pilot we'd like an explicit opt-out window tied to a two-phase ramp (so we can downscale without penalty in month 3 if adoption stalls). Concretely:

- Pilot length: 6 months
- If we choose to downscale at month 3, we'd prefer a 30-day opt-out with a pro-rated credit rather than the standard early-termination charge.
- If termination happens after month 3, we accept a 60-day notice + 50% of remaining committed fees as a termination payment.

Is that something Redwood can consider? Procurement attached the pilot MPA and a clean doc with the asked language.

Attachments: Nebula_Pilot_MPA.xlsx (spreadsheet), requested_exit_language.docx

Appreciate a quick read — Evan
Evan Cole

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Evan's ask from Nebula.

Short summary / ask: Nebula wants a pilot-specific opt-out that effectively allows a mid-pilot downscale at month 3 with a 30-day pro-rated credit (instead of the standard early-term fees), and a softer termination formula (60-day notice + 50% remaining) post-month-3. They framed it as a pilot safety net to encourage adoption.

What I need:
- Karthik: commercial recommendation (capacity impact, precedent, suggested cap on credits)
- Laura: legal redline — can we allow a one-off concession limited to this pilot and do it as an addendum that expires with the pilot?
- Marissa (cc) — FYI, likely needs exec sign-off if legal flags non-standard financial exposure.

I'll hold on responding to Evan until we have direction.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:58:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: proposal tweak for early-exit & ramp wording — legal redline

Rishi / Karthik — quick legal read: we can accept a limited pilot addendum but require strict guardrails so this doesn't become a standing precedent. Proposed terms (high level):

1) Pilot addendum only — auto-terminates at pilot end unless both parties sign a renewal.
2) Mid-pilot downscale ("mid-pilot opt-out"): allow a one-time downscale election at month 3 with a 30-day notice; credit limited to the lesser of (a) pro-rated unused committed spend or (b) USD 50k cap. Credits must offset future invoices only (no cash refunds).
3) Post-month-3 termination: 60-day notice + 50% of remaining committed fees as termination charge (as requested) — acceptable but require a maximum cap of USD 150k.
4) Require procurement to acknowledge no concurrent usage of other pilot credits or overlapping concessions.
5) Add an explicit no-precedent clause: this concession is non-binding for future deals and requires separate exec approval to replicate.

I've attached a marked-up addendum (procurement_terms_nebula.docx) with redlines and suggested language. If commercial OKs the caps, Legal can finalize the addendum for signature (DocuSign).

Attachment: procurement_terms_nebula.docx

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: proposal tweak for early-exit & ramp wording — exec clearance

Team — I reviewed Laura's redlines and the commercial ask. I am willing to sign off on the following guardrails for this pilot only:

- Mid-pilot one-time downscale with 30-day notice and pro-rated credit capped at USD 50k.
- Post-month-3 termination formula with 60-day notice and 50% remaining charge capped at USD 150k.
- Credits are invoice-only (no refunds) and cap applies per-account, not per-pilot.
- Legal to include explicit non-precedent language.

Condition: Finance must confirm the credit/accounting treatment is acceptable and we record the concession in the deal record (HubSpot). Karthik, please coordinate finance sign-off — if finance flags material exposure, pull back to me.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the MPA. We've reviewed internally and can accommodate a pilot addendum with guarded concessions. High-level summary of the agreed approach (we'll send a short addendum for signature):

- Pilot-only addendum that expires at the end of the 6-month pilot unless renewed.
- Mid-pilot downscale: one-time election at month 3, 30-day notice required. Credit will be pro-rated and limited to the lesser of the unused committed spend or USD 50,000. Credits applied as account invoice credits (no cash refunds).
- Post-month-3 termination: 60-day notice plus a termination charge equal to 50% of remaining committed fees, capped at USD 150,000.
- Addendum will include a non-precedent clause and a single-use concession label.

Action items next:
1) Legal to finalize redline into a short addendum (attached).
2) We'll send the addendum via DocuSign for signature once Finance confirms accounting.
3) Karthik/Finance to confirm credit treatment (cc'd).

I've attached the draft addendum and the mutual action plan for your review. If anything here is a blocker for Nebula, let me know and we'll route for exec review.
